run_relicense_script: run the python script to replace LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers in all files under a directory
run_update_function: run the update function to replace an LGPL3 license header with an MPL2 license header in text
review_update_function: review the update function that checks for and replaces LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers
refactor_relicense_script: refactor the relicense script to use Python 3 syntax and context managers for file I/O
test_update_function: test the update function to verify it correctly replaces LGPL3 headers with MPL2 headers
